description: Patch-level bumps are automerged. Jackett keeps no database and no migrations - its entire state is a handful of JSON files it rewrites in place - and the Molecule scenario asserts that the container a bump produced reports exactly the version this repository pins.
Under `semver` every Jackett release arrives as a patch, because the leading `0.24` moves roughly once a year; the minor bump that does move it still becomes a pull request for a human to look at.
